language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

Hello, I am Tim.

Hi there! My father owns a shrimp trawler to catch shrimp. I help him with loading the gear, taking care of the crew's clothing, loading the correct equipment and ordering supplies. I'm excited to help him! There are a lot of different kinds of materials on the boat. Some of these materials are natural, like wood and gold. Other materials are made by men, like plastic. Together we can try to find out what kind of materials are on the trawler!
Let's get started!
Look at all the stuff I found on board! A lot of these items are made from materials that you can find in nature.
For example, did you know that paper is made from wood?
And most of the clothes you’re wearing are made from cotton, which is a plant! Do you know which material the following items are made from?

Father needs a new anchor for the trawler. I am going to research some of the materials to replace it. I found some steel, aluminum and iron. Will you please help me answer questions about
these materials?
